projects.name: Orbital Fabrication
projects.benefit: LOWER CORVETTE COST AND BUILD TIME
projects.description: Ceres yard crews developed jigs that let a single tug build and align a hull in free fall. Standardizing the design makes every new corvette cheaper and faster to produce.

projects.name: Fire Control
projects.description: Separate hulls can share a firing solution before their weapons open up. A synchronized track gives our escorts more time to shoot before reaching a convoy.

projects.name: Fleet Escort Systems
projects.description: The Mariner trades acceleration for armor, reactor capacity and a heavier battery. It can escort fragile expedition hulls through a contested arrival.

projects.name: Habitat Engineering
projects.benefit: BUILD O'NEILL HABITATS AND SUPPORT FUSION FLIGHTS
projects.description: Closed-loop water and air systems keep crews alive through long missions. The same design makes rotating habitats and their industrial capacity possible.

projects.name: Long Burn Drive
projects.description: A reworked heat rejection loop lets ships sustain a burn long enough to reach the outer worlds. The new drive also increases acceleration on local transfers.

projects.name: Deep Sky Astrometry
projects.benefit: CHART NEARBY STARS AND SCAN FASTER
projects.description: Combining long-baseline observations gives Sol a chart of nearby systems. It also improves the instruments on every survey scout.

projects.name: Pulsed Fusion
projects.benefit: IMPROVE SCOUT AND FLEET TRANSIT TIMES
projects.description: Long-duration fusion burns cut travel time along surveyed interstellar routes and unlock the long range drive package.

projects.name: Fleet Logistics
projects.description: Standardize hot-swappable machinery and resupply manifests. Fleet upkeep falls, at the expense of heavy extraction subsidies.

projects.name: Heavy Industry
projects.benefit: MORE ORE FROM EACH EXTRACTION SITE
projects.description: Dense processing plants improve mine and skimmer output. The alternative logistics subsidy is unavailable once this program begins.

projects.name: Precision Interferometry
projects.description: Dedicated interferometers improve precision and shorten a scout survey. Wide search arrays use the same production capacity.

projects.name: Wide Search Arrays
projects.benefit: EARN MORE ORE PER COMPLETED SURVEY
projects.description: Wide-band searches recover more salvage per complete survey. They trade precise sampling for wider coverage.

projects.name: Heavy Hull Frames
projects.description: A reinforced modular frame supports larger reactors and navigation packages. Integrate it at an orbital shipyard.

projects.name: Capital Hull Frames
projects.description: Parallel slips make very large hulls possible. Their costs and naval capacity requirements still apply.

projects.name: Long Range Gunnery
projects.description: Range-finding and fire-control software work together. Your electronics program cannot also develop advanced shield fields.

projects.name: Shield Harmonization
projects.description: Sustain a reinforced field at the cost of power and the long-range targeting program.

projects.name: Surface Engineering
projects.description: Improve extraction and observation at existing staffed colonies. Upgrades preserve the original structure slot.

projects.name: Orbital Engineering
projects.description: Upgrade labs, shipyards, power, and logistics platforms in place.
